header: Developers love Postgres, and Timescale is built on it. I spearheaded the State of Postgres report as a growth initiative. I led the concept, design, art direction, and animation.

summary.outcome: Thousands of signups; became a yearly report

layout.title: Background
text: Postgres was more popular than ever, and the developers using it were exactly who Timescale wanted to reach. The idea was to give them something genuinely useful: a survey of the Postgres community, published as an immersive story, with a newsletter signup for anyone who wanted more.

layout.title: Beyond a spreadsheet
text: Developer reports usually look like a boring spreadsheet. I wanted this one to feel like an event, so I gave it a dark, editorial layout and built it around a series of fun 3D elephants, the Postgres mascot. The goal was a report people would want to share, not just skim.

layout.title: Building it
text: I illustrated each elephant by hand first, then modeled it in 3D and animated it in Blender. Finally, I brought each animated sequence into Three.js, where I lit it for the web.

layout.title: Giving the quotes a personality
text: Survey quotes can read like a wall of text, so each one got its own small 3D moment. A fidget spinner for the developer who picked MongoDB because it was the latest fad, a wagging tail for the one who never fell for the hype.

layout.title: Result
text: It brought in thousands of newsletter signups, and worked well enough that State of Postgres became a yearly report.
